description: Support conversations from the brand's OWN Intercom inbox, newest activity first: subject, state, whether the customer is waiting, assignee, customer email, channel, tags and the first message. One Intercom workspace can serve several products, so every filter below combines with the others. view: open (default), unassigned, waiting (customer waiting on a reply), snoozed, closed, recent or all. days bounds it by last update (default 30), or use updatedAfter / updatedBefore / createdAfter / createdBefore (dates). text matches words in the first message; email is the customer's exact email, customer is part of their name or email; contactId; assigneeId (a teammate) or teamId (ids from list_intercom_teammates); tagId or tagName; channel (conversation is the Messenger, or email, whatsapp, sms and so on); priority true or false; unread true. app is the product the customer wrote from (their contact's current_app, case-insensitive, for example Hermoso); contactAttributes and attributes match other custom attributes of the customer or of the conversation. Intercom's search cannot filter on custom attributes or app, so those are matched on the pages read and the answer says how many it read. Pass cursor from the last answer for the next page. Read-only, free. Needs Intercom connected (Connectors > Intercom, or connect_connector).

app.description: the product the customer wrote from: their contact's current_app attribute, for example Hermoso

assigneeId.description: the teammate id it is assigned to (list_intercom_teammates)

attributes.description: { name: value } custom attributes of the conversation

channel.description: where the conversation started; conversation is the Messenger

contactAttributes.description: { name: value } custom attributes of the customer's contact record

customer.description: part of the customer's name or email

days.description: 1-365, default 30: conversations updated in the last N days

priority.description: true = only priority conversations, false = only non-priority

tagId.description: Intercom tag id to filter by, from the Intercom tags list

tagName.description: a tag name, resolved to its id; use instead of tagId

teamId.description: the team id it is assigned to (list_intercom_teammates)

text.description: words that appear in the first message

unread.description: true = only conversations no teammate has read

name: list_intercom_conversations
title: List Intercom conversations
